item.title: 微软与 Mistral 达成的数十亿美元协议为受监管行业提供欧洲替代方案，摆脱美国控制的 AI
item.summary: Microsoft's decision to pour billions of dollars into Mistral's European compute base is less about adding another model to Azure than about answering a question that has grown loud across the region's boardrooms and ministries: can enterprises run frontier AI without ceding control of their data to US-operated infrast
